nieuw.titel: Angle charges to keep enemy characters out of base contact
nieuw.tekst: Position your charger so it can maximise contact with ordinary models without touching the enemy character. Under the interpretation he is using, a character already in the fighting rank cannot shift sideways to meet the charger and is limited to one attack without base contact.
nieuw.waarom: He found that careful positioning let his relatively weak unit beat the ordinary troops while minimising the stronger character's attacks.
nieuw.voorbeeld: His Razorgor Herd charged Hobgoblin Wolf Riders without contacting their Hobgoblin Khan. He killed two or three riders, made the unit flee and ran it down.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He says the character-placement rules are hazy and acknowledges that other groups may play this differently.

bronnen.citaat: the key to all of this is the angle at which you position your model

extraCitaten.citaat: really minimized the ability of the character strike back

overgeslagen: Skipped introductory rules explanation and command-group placement ambiguities as standalone lessons, game-result remarks, and the unclear closing phrase about angling a return charge.
